newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Tuesday as the market kept an eye on further developments in Malaysia, traders said.
Traders said two tenders were done in the afternoon in Medan, North Sumatra for crude palm oil at 1,173 rupiah/kg and 1,158 rupiah/kg respectively. The tender was for 500 tonnes each.

"Demand is not too good and traders are waiting for further developments in Malaysia. Many traders are still on the sidelines and maybe we can see some fresh movement in the market tomorrow," said one trader in Medan.
Traders said palm olein was stable at 1,385-90 rupiah/kg in Jakarta.
The Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said in Kuala Lumpur, after the close of morning session, that June palm oil output fell 0.6 percent to 787,807 tonnes versus May's 792,540.
June palm oil exports were 612,124 tonnes against 633,507 in May, and end-June stocks rose 10.37 percent to 786,123 tonnes from 712,289 at end-May.
